subject.title: [Bug] Upgrading from 5.28 → 6.1: cron store migrated to SQLite silently, but new jobs default to delivery.mode=announce causing channel errors

question: For isolated cron jobs with no explicit delivery setting, should OpenClaw preserve implicit announce behavior with a safe no-channel fallback, or change the default to silent delivery for future and upgraded jobs?
rationale: Both choices affect existing scheduled-work expectations and the linked PR changes a user-visible default; source-level migration repair can proceed only after the delivery contract is chosen.

options.title: Default omitted delivery to none
options.body: Adopt the linked PR direction so newly created and legacy-unspecified isolated jobs complete silently unless the user explicitly requests announcement.

options.title: Preserve announce with safe fallback
options.body: Keep implicit announcement semantics but make a missing delivery channel a delivery-only warning rather than a failed job run.

recommendation.title: Default omitted delivery to none
recommendation.body: Adopt the linked PR direction so newly created and legacy-unspecified isolated jobs complete silently unless the user explicitly requests announcement.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue and linked implementation both identify the cron area as the relevant ownership boundary.
